character_description: Middle-aged male in his early 40s, calm and deep voice, authoritative and observant tone, measured deliberate pacing, wise and perceptive quality, experienced appraiser with quiet confidence and gravitas. Studio-quality recording.
audition_line: 真正的鉴赏家不会被品类所局限。我看的不是物品的类别，而是它内在的品质和价值。只要东西够好，不管是古董还是珠宝，我都有把握判断它的真实价值，这就是我的本事。
